data.about: The same four-panel truss as page 1, loaded asymmetrically: 60 kN at the quarter point and 20 kN at midspan. The reactions come out 55 and 25 kN, and one member does something page 1’s symmetric case never did — diagonal L1–U2 goes into tension. Slide the load between F1 and F2, keeping the total at 80 kN, and it crosses zero at F1 = 53.33 kN. That is the whole reason this task exists: a web member’s sign belongs to the load case, not to the truss.
